definitions.explanation: Widely accepted or applying to most cases; not specialized or exceptional.

examples.japanese: {一般的|いっぱんてき}に、{日本人|にほんじん}は{礼儀正|れいぎただ}しいと{言|い}われています。
examples.english: Generally, Japanese people are said to be polite.

examples.japanese: これは{一般的|いっぱんてき}な{方法|ほうほう}です。
{一般的|いっぱんてき}には{賛成|さんせい}されています。

notes: Very common word used to describe what is typical or widely applicable. {一般的|いっぱんてき}に (generally) is a common adverbial form. Opposite of {特殊|とくしゅ}な or {例外的|れいがいてき}な (exceptional).
